excerpt: Can You Reapply After a Study Visa Refusal in Canada? Step-by-Step Guide Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. A well-written Statement of Purpose (SOP) is one of the most important components of your Canadian study permit application. While many applicants focus solely on admission letters or financial documents, visa officers rely heavily on the SOP to assess your intentions, credibility, and plans. A weak or unclear SOP is one of the most common reasons for study visa refusals. In this guide, we explain: Why the SOP matters for IRCC
author: Anuj Sengar
